ITEM 1 | Pale yellow-white flattened piece with slightly translucent, glossy edges and a few darker green-brown patches, sitting at the right side of the container, about 6 x 4 cm, soft and limp with a moist look, possibly coated with a light film of oil or sauce | 45
ITEM 2 | Dark green, slightly wilted leafy material with a glossy, moist sheen, partly tucked under the pale piece on the right, about 5 x 3 cm, thin and flat | 15
ITEM 3 | Cluster of small rounded brown-tan pieces with smooth caps and slightly wrinkled surfaces, glossy and moist-looking, grouped together in the lower right of the container, about 7 x 5 cm total, each piece about 2 to 3 cm across, firm and holding shape | 90
ITEM 4 | Two separate single small rounded brown-tan pieces with smooth glossy caps and short stems, lying at the left-center of the container, each about 2 to 2.5 cm across, firm and holding shape | 20
ITEM 5 | Small brown-tan rounded piece, smooth and slightly glossy, sitting alone near the center-left of the container, about 1.5 cm across, firm | 6
ITEM 6 | Thin ribbon and ring-shaped slices of red-purple onion with translucent pale edges, loosely curled and scattered in the center of the container, about 5 x 4 cm total, moist and limp | 12
